summary: Tested Valet Guys refactored backend (modular routers) and frontend UI changes. All 22 backend API tests passed. Frontend verified: VALET GUYS branding on login, COMING SOON tags on Dashboard tips card and AdminReporting financial section.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login - Super admin login with email/password
Backend: GET /api/auth/me - Returns user data with correct fields
Backend: GET /api/super-admin/clients - Returns clients list
Backend: GET /api/super-admin/analytics - Returns analytics object
Backend: POST /api/super-admin/admins - Creates new admin
Backend: POST /api/auth/otp/request - Sends OTP to admin phone
Backend: POST /api/auth/otp/verify - Verifies OTP and returns token
Backend: GET /api/admin/valets - Returns valets list
Backend: POST /api/admin/valets - Creates a valet
Backend: PUT /api/admin/valets/{valet_id}/toggle-online - Toggles valet online status
Backend: POST /api/vehicles - Creates a vehicle
Backend: GET /api/vehicles - Returns vehicle list
Backend: GET /api/vehicles/lookup - Looks up vehicle by phone
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve - Creates a retrieval ticket
Backend: GET /api/tickets - Returns ticket list
Backend: PUT /api/tickets/{ticket_id}/claim - Claims a ticket
Backend: PUT /api/tickets/{ticket_id}/status - Updates ticket status
Backend: GET /api/valet/dashboard-stats - Returns valet stats
Backend: GET /api/admin/dashboard-stats - Returns admin dashboard stats
Backend: POST /api/admin/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/checkout - Checks out a vehicle
Backend: GET /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id} - Returns vehicle retrieval info (public, no auth)
Backend: POST /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id}/confirm - Confirms retrieval (public, no auth)
Backend: GET /api/push/vapid-key - Returns VAPID key
Backend: GET /api/admin/reporting - Returns reporting data
Frontend: Login page shows 'VALET GUYS' branding
Frontend: Dashboard tips card shows 'COMING SOON' tag
Frontend: AdminReporting financial section shows 'COMING SOON' tag
critical_code_review_comments: Backend refactoring from monolithic server.py to modular routers is well-structured
All routes properly prefixed with /api and organized by domain (auth, vehicles, tickets, admin, super_admin, public)
Thank-you message correctly updated to 'Thank you for parking at [Client Name]. We hope you enjoyed your time here.\nThe Valet Guys'
Tips/payment UI properly hidden with 'COMING SOON' tags
